I answered Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Marcus is in. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. The cause was one trailer appearing twice: the driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch also added him manually. I also told Marcus that Dana owns the account and was looking into it.

That same Aug 20 post also had a seat count. I left it out because it doesn't answer Marcus's question.
